body.prose: Well, I am leaning towards allowing multiple owners. I am. But it's not entirely justified really. Apart from a gut feeling. Because I want open-endedness. And it just resonates more with reality to me. But that's gut feeling. However, we are missing something here. If a brief is space, that is different from linking through fields, because briefs currently link through prose links and through fields. So we might be looking at a refactor of briefs, and we might be pre-concluding our discussion on briefs and dimensions too early here. Do you see my point?
body.title: Not concluding briefs too early
